summary: Textual-based `sox chat` TUI that spawns a SOX MCP server as a stdio subprocess (per docs/decisions/tui-connection-model.md) and renders channels, threads, agents, and a compose bar. The TUI is just another MCP client — no privileged paths. Live updates via reactive watchers fed by an asyncio task draining recv() polls (forward-compatible with watch() when it lands). A reproducible two-agent demo script drives a 45s scripted conversation that is captured deterministically with vhs (Charm) into both .cast (asciinema-compatible) and a .gif rendered for the README. Owns primitive-coverage slots that benefit from live visuals: dm/<sorted-pair> channel creation via /dm, channels_heartbeat liveness in agent_roster, and the choreographed two-agent recording. Coverage divides cleanly with chat-webapp (replay scrubber, group sidebar) and reference-agent (annotated single-agent lifecycle).

panes.name: channel_list
panes.purpose: All subscribed channels grouped by prefix (group/, dm/, sox/, free-form). Active channel highlighted; unread badge per channel; subscriber count from list_channels.

panes.name: message_feed
panes.purpose: Live-tailing message log for the focused channel. Threads collapsed by default; Enter expands inline reply chain. Shows sender, sent_at, body summary, ACK/NACK/pending status icon.

panes.name: agent_roster
panes.purpose: Connected agents with presence indicator (live/stale/unknown) sourced from heartbeat, and unread DM count. Enter on an agent issues /dm <agent>.

panes.name: compose_bar
panes.purpose: Single-line input. Plain text sends to focused channel. Slash commands: /reply <id>, /dm <agent>, /join <channel>, /quit.

interactions: arrow keys to navigate channel_list and agent_roster
enter to expand thread or open DM
/dm <agent_id> to open a direct channel (creates dm/<sorted-pair>)
/quit to exit (sends SIGTERM to spawned server)

files.purpose: Public package surface. Re-exports SoxChatApp and run().
Textual App composing the four panes; owns the McpStdioClient and background RecvPump task; wires reactive ChatStore into widgets via watch().
Pure dataclasses + reactive store: ChannelState, MessageState, AgentState, ChatStore. No I/O. ChatStore exposes ingest_message(), focus_channel(), update_agents(); emits change events.
Async wrapper around an MCP stdio session. Speaks JSON-RPC framed MCP over the spawned subprocess pipes. Typed async methods send/recv/subscribe/list_channels/list_agents/heartbeat.
Subprocess lifecycle: spawn `python -m sox_protocol.cli serve --transport stdio`, run initialize handshake, capture stderr, graceful shutdown on TUI exit.
Pure parser for compose-bar slash commands. parse(text) -> Command union (Send|Reply|Dm|Join|Quit). DM command resolves to dm/<sorted-pair> per spec/primitives/dms.md.
Textual ListView bound to ChatStore.channels reactive. Renders name, subscriber count, unread badge. Emits ChannelFocused on selection.
VerticalScroll widget rendering messages for the focused channel. Collapsible threads via Enter on a parent message.
ListView of agents with presence dot (heartbeat-driven) and DM badge. Emits AgentSelected for /dm flow.
Input widget; on submit, parses via commands.parse and emits ComposeSubmitted(Command).
Background asyncio task: polls McpStdioClient.recv() at 250ms cadence (forward-compatible with watch()), feeds messages into ChatStore.ingest_message(). Cancellation-safe.
`sox chat` CLI subcommand. Argparse: --agent-id (default tui-user), --server-cmd (default local), --no-spawn (attach to existing). Boots SoxChatApp.
embed demo gif asset in project README
VHS tape script for deterministic recording
rendered GIF from demo.cast for README embed

choreography.action: spawn sox MCP server (stdio) as subprocess; agents A and B connect
agent A subscribes to #general; agent B subscribes to #general
spawn TUI viewer (sox chat) attached to same server as observer
agent A sends 'hey, can you review the threads spec?' to #general
agent B recv()s, ACKs message via channels__ack
agent B sends reply with reply_to=msg-A-1 ('on it — checking section 4')
agent A recv()s reply, sends thread follow-up: 'thanks, focus on ordering guarantees'
agent B opens DM to agent A: 'one question — is ordering per-channel or global?'
agent A replies in DM: 'per-channel; see sequence-numbers.md'
agent B sends NACK on a synthetic broken request to demo error envelope
agent B sends final reply to thread: 'LGTM, approving'
agent A acks final reply; list_pending shows zero unreplied
TUI viewer pans channel_list -> message_feed -> agent_roster to showcase all panes
graceful shutdown: agents disconnect, TUI exits, server SIGTERM

recording_strategy.post_process: vhs renders examples/two-agents-talking/demo.tape into docs/media/demo.gif AND a sibling docs/media/demo.cast (asciinema-compatible). Both committed. README embeds the .gif.
recording_strategy.rationale: vhs (Charm) takes a declarative .tape script and produces frame-perfect output deterministically — strictly better than asciinema-record which captures wall-clock human input. The .tape lives next to demo.py so the recording is regenerable on any machine with vhs installed; CI can rebuild it. .gif embeds cleanly in GitHub README without a player widget; .cast retained for asciinema embed in launch posts.

test_plan: tests/tui/test_commands.py — unit-test parse() across send/reply/dm/join/quit and malformed inputs (100% branch coverage on commands.py).
tests/tui/test_state.py — ChatStore ingest, focus, dedup by message_id, unread counter, agent presence transitions; deterministic, no async.
tests/tui/test_process_manager.py — spawn fake server (stub `python -c` script), assert handshake, terminate, crash-stderr capture; uses tmp_path and asyncio.
tests/tui/test_mcp_client.py — mock subprocess transport with a JSON-RPC echo; assert send/recv/subscribe round-trips and JSON framing.
tests/tui/test_pump.py — fake McpStdioClient yielding scripted messages; assert ChatStore receives them and cancellation drains cleanly.

tests/tui/test_app_pilot.py — textual.pilot smoke test: boot SoxChatApp with in-process fake McpStdioClient, simulate keystrokes (focus pane, type message, submit), assert ChatStore mutations and compose_bar clears. Rendering glue may be omitted from coverage gate via documented conftest pragmas.
tests/tui/test_demo_script.py — run examples/two-agents-talking/demo.py against an in-process server fixture, assert final list_pending state and message ordering — guarantees reproducibility.
risks: Textual reactive watchers fire on the UI thread; ChatStore mutations must stay sync and cheap. Mitigation: dataclass-only state, computed views in widgets.
Subprocess stderr buffering can hide crash causes. Mitigation: ServerProcess captures stderr line-by-line and surfaces last 20 lines on TUI exit.
vhs is not in CI default toolchain. Mitigation: commit pre-rendered demo.gif and demo.cast; document regeneration in demo.py module docstring (not a separate .md).
Demo timing skew on slow machines could exceed 60s budget. Mitigation: choreography uses absolute t-anchors with sleep_until(t), not cumulative sleeps.
Identity primitive not yet shipped — TUI cannot present credentials. Accepted: TUI sends an unauth handshake; will be retrofitted when credential registry lands.
